name: Core Passive: Endless Wind
Additional Ability: Optimal Orchestration
desc:
When another character in your squad is <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Stun]</color>, or shares the same Faction:
When Severian enters combat or switches on field, his ATK increases by 100 points. This effect scales with character Lv., increasing by 10 points per level, up to a maximum increase of 700 points. Lasts for 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

1.name: Severian_Talent_01_Title
1.desc:
Gain 100 <color=#FFFFFF>[Flow]</color> upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Severian's Basic Attack CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.

2.name: Severian_Talent_02_Title
2.desc:
When Severian enters the field via <color=#FFFFFF>[Entry Skill: Clearing Time]</color>, the skill is replaced with a <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack]</color>. The entry type of this skill will not be changed. This effect can trigger at most once every 20 second(s).
Each time Severian uses <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gale Shadow Hunt]</color>, he gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>[Wind Riding]</color>.
When Severian triggers <color=#FFFFFF>[Core Passive: Optimal Arrangement]</color>, he additionally increases his own ATK by 15%.

4.name: Severian_Talent_04_Title
4.desc: When Severian triggers <color=#FFFFFF>[Perfect Dodge]</color> or uses <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Galewind Shadow Hunt]</color>, his attacks ignore 16% of enemies' DEF for 15s.

6.name: Severian_Talent_06_Title
6.desc:
Severian's <color=#FFFFFF>[Flowing Breath]</color> upper limit increases to 180.
<color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Pale Wind Shadow Hunt]</color> final hit's extra DMG Multiplier receives a fixed increase of 900%.
Upon releasing the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Pale Wind Shadow Hunt]</color>, gain the <color=#FFFFFF>[Wind Rise]</color> effect: accumulates 10 point(s) of <color=#FFFFFF>[Flowing Breath]</color> per second for 3s; repeated triggers reset the duration.
